items.hed: Mavericks beat the Rockets 116-111 in Dallas on Friday night
items.insight: The NBA schedule lists Friday's Emirates NBA Cup game final, Houston 111, Dallas 116, at American Airlines Center. That drops the Rockets to 5-1. Oklahoma City is listed at Toyota Center tonight, Saturday, Oct. 31, at 8:30 p.m. ET. No tip result is posted, so none is printed here.

items.hed: Texans are on a bye this weekend, then play the Chargers on Nov. 8
items.insight: The Houston Texans schedule lists Week 8, the weekend of Nov. 1, as a bye, with no kickoff and no score. Sunday, Oct. 25, was a home game against the New York Giants at Reliant Stadium, noon CT on Fox. The page still carries that line as a scheduled matchup and does not print a final, so none is printed here. Next game listed is Nov. 8 at the Los Angeles Chargers, 3:05 p.m. CT, on CBS, at SoFi Stadium.

items.hed: Astros active roster still lists Hader, Imai, Brown, and Blanco
items.insight: MLB.com's Houston active roster still lists pitchers Ronel Blanco, Hunter Brown, Josh Hader, and Tatsuya Imai among the arms. It is an offseason list, not a game. The roster page shows no new transaction line.
